mapper.select: SELECT FARM_STATUS_NUM as farmStatusNum, NO2_DATA as no2Data, TEMP_DATA as tempData, HUM_DATA as humData, LUX_DATA as luxData, CO2_DATA as co2Data, NH3_DATA as nh3Data, REC_TIME as recTime, FARM_ID as farmId FROM farm_status WHERE FARM_ID = #{farmId} AND DATE(REC_TIME) = STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY REC_TIME ASC

SELECT CONCAT(DATE(REC_TIME), ' 00:00:00') as recTime, AVG(NO2_DATA) as no2Data, AVG(TEMP_DATA) as tempData, AVG(HUM_DATA) as humData, AVG(LUX_DATA) as luxData, AVG(CO2_DATA) as co2Data, AVG(NH3_DATA) as nh3Data, #{farmId} as farmId FROM farm_status WHERE FARM_ID = #{farmId} AND DATE(REC_TIME) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(REC_TIME) ORDER BY DATE(REC_TIME) ASC

SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(REC_TIME, '%Y-%m'), '-01 00:00:00') as recTime, AVG(NO2_DATA) as no2Data, AVG(TEMP_DATA) as tempData, AVG(HUM_DATA) as humData, AVG(LUX_DATA) as luxData, AVG(CO2_DATA) as co2Data, AVG(NH3_DATA) as nh3Data, #{farmId} as farmId FROM farm_status WHERE FARM_ID = #{farmId} AND YEAR(REC_TIME) = YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(REC_TIME, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(REC_TIME, '%Y-%m') ASC

SELECT FARM_STATUS_NUM as farmStatusNum, NO2_DATA as no2Data, TEMP_DATA as tempData, HUM_DATA as humData, LUX_DATA as luxData, CO2_DATA as co2Data, NH3_DATA as nh3Data, REC_TIME as recTime, FARM_ID as farmId FROM farm_status WHERE FARM_ID = #{farmId} ORDER BY REC_TIME DESC LIMIT 1
